_doc: Objectives shown in the top-left corner, per zone. An objective is done when its flag is set. 'after' hides it until that flag is set (unless it is already done). {name} is replaced by Game.counters[name]. One general aim per realm: no checklists (open-world progression).

shifting.text: Find the EXIT (it moves if you leave it alone)

city.text: Wander. Find somewhere quiet to rest

above.text: Find a way down from here

blackout.text: Find a way out of Larkspur Lane

stilllife.text: Find a way out of the arcade
